docstring:
The Bombieri–Vinogradov theorem: the Elliott–Halberstam conjecture holds for every
$\theta < 1/2$. This result may be regarded as an averaged form of the generalized
Riemann hypothesis.
references: [EH68] Elliott, Peter D. T. A. and Halberstam, Heini, *A conjecture in prime number theory*, Symposia Mathematica, Vol. IV (INDAM, Rome, 1968/69), 59–72.
[FG89] Friedlander, John and Granville, Andrew, *Limitations to the equi-distribution of primes I*, Ann. of Math. (2) 129 (1989), no. 2, 363–382.
type_pretty:
∀ θ < 1 / 2,
  ∀ (A : ℝ),
    0 < A →
      ∃ C > 0,
        ∀ (x : ℕ), 2 < x → ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊↑x ^ θ⌋₊, ElliottHalberstamConjecture.E x q ≤ C * ↑x / Real.log ↑x ^ A
